facts.statement: Community Ambassadors were present at the Luau Beach Party to ask trivia questions, dance in the surf and answer player questions about the game.
facts.quote: Our Community Ambassadors will be on hand to ask trivia questions, dance in the surf

facts.statement: Free Realms Community Ambassadors run weekly community events where players race karts, show off houses, duel and take part in other activities.
facts.quote: The Free Realms Community Ambassadors throw weekly events where everyone can get together and race karts

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Community Event: Luau Beach Party)
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms community event announcement for a Luau Beach Party held in Seaside on Server 1 in late March 2011. It describes the event activities, the Community Ambassadors' role, and the ways players could obtain clothing (quests, web codes, vendors, Station Cash). The posting date is given only as a relative age ('1 week, 1 day ago') so the exact post date is unknown.

article_summaries.title: Event Recap: Home Show and Pet Parade
article_summaries.summary: A French-localized official Free Realms news page recapping two community events: a New Year Home Show where players toured decorated player houses, and a Dress Up Your Pet Day parade that started at Wugachug and marched to Sanctuary. It also explains how to find community events through the Game Guide calendar and the GO button. The page gives only a relative posting time ('1 day, 13 hours ago'), so the exact event dates are not recorded.
